text.en:
9th. JULY, 2002 No. S40

BRUNEI NATIONAL PETROLEUM COMPANY

SENDIRIAN BERHAD ORDER, 2002 (S 6/2002) Notice on the granting of mineral rights by His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council (section 3{1)) It is hereby notifi.ed that His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council has on 23rd. day of April, 2002 pursuant to subsection {1) of section 3 of the Brunei National Petroleum Company Sendirian Berhad Order, 2002, granted all mineral rights to the Brunei National Petroleum Company Sendirian Berhad within such area of State Land referred to as Block L having the following coordinates -..

POINT EASTING NORTHING POINT EASTING NORTHING 619,141.563 565,406.625 OF08 539,252.188 530,321.500 4 615,676.000 564, 123.170 OF07 533,410.020 525,843.060 5 601,865.000 566,346.000 SE1 535,580.375 524,257.813 OF75 573,482.813 555,960.750 SE2 541,805.313 512,134.406 OF12 570,279.813 554,639.313 12 546,233.688 503,439.188 OFll 565,305.438 550,888.188 LS1 545,760.375 502,006.688 OF10 562,569.375 548,487.625 LS2 556,903.188 502,038.813 OF09 540,805.688 LT01 569,910.625 502,139.400 537,666.250 T1 530,000.000 537,070.940 T2 530,000.000 543,971.688 534,495.063 T3 600,000.000 535,000.000 The line between Point LT01 and Point T4 612,274.700 535,000.000 T1 and the line between Point 4 and Point 3 follow the international boundary. Dated this 27th. day of June, 2002.

PEHIN ORANG KAYA PEKERMA JAYA

DATO PADUKA HAJI JUDIN BIN HAJI ASAR Clerk to the Council of Ministers, Brunei Darussalam.
